newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP says completes U.S. non-core sales.
newsitem.headline: BHP says completes U.S. non-core sales.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday it has completed its major programme of divesting non-strategic North American assets as announced in October 1995.

BHP said its BHP Petroluem unit had sold its interest in a package of gas field units in Wyoming, U.S., to the Louisiana Land and Exploration company, the last of seven major Americas Region non-strategic assets sales undertaken since October 1995.
BHP said it has sold interests in over 1,800 wells in more than 100 fields in the United States, Canada and Argentina, generating a total of US$313 million in cash.

"The divestment program was part of an overall strategic effort to re-focus BHP Petroleum's Americas growth portfolio in the deepwater Gulf of Mexico, and select opportunities in Latin America," the company said in a statement.

BHP said it had retained three offshore oil and gas properties in the Gulf of Mexico and had established a major exploration leaseholding position in the deepwater and ultradeepwater of the Gulf of Mexico.
The company said about a third of its 1998 financial year exploration expenditure would be committed to exploration activities in this area. -- Melbourne Bureau 61-3 9286-1435
